title: Relative Clauses Referring to the Whole Sentence

instruction.text: Decide if the relative clause is referring to a noun or the whole sentence.

atoms.a: I lost my favourite fridge magnet, <u>which was really sad</u>.
Kyle ate too much, <u>which made him ill</u>.
Sadie just got a new car, <u>which is blue</u>.
We went to the beach, <u>which was really busy</u>.

instruction.text: Select the relative clause that refers to the whole sentence.

atoms.a: There was no more milk in the supermarket...
atoms.b: There was no more milk in the supermarket, ((++which_was_a_problem which_is_in_town)).

atoms.a: We were snowed in this morning...
atoms.b: We were snowed in this morning, ((++which_was_exciting which_is_heavy)).

atoms.a: The new restaurant in town was full...
atoms.b: The new restaurant in town was full, ((++which_was_a_shame which_is_Indian)).
